THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

Your class writes to a school in another country. You are alone in the library workroom. That school sent a copy of a letter from 1885. A girl named Marit wrote it to her sister. They asked what Marit wanted her sister to believe. Four people each have one part of the answer.

THE HISTORY

Marit's letter is an America letter. Long ago, people who moved to America wrote letters home. People read these letters to their whole town. One letter could change who moved next.
